privacy.seoDescription: Privacy policy for Quiz Couple - Personal data protection and GDPR compliance.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy defines and informs you of how Quiz Couple uses and protects the information you provide to us, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s2_1Intro: To improve your experience, we use your browser's local storage (LocalStorage) for:
privacy.s2_1Item2: Remembering your theme preferences (light or dark mode)
privacy.s2_1Item3: Keeping results from your previous quizzes
privacy.s2_1ImportantText: This data is stored exclusively on your device and is never transmitted to our servers or to third parties. You can delete it at any time by clearing your browser's browsing data.
privacy.s2_2Intro: Some features are open without an account. To stop the same person leaving ten reviews on the same test or voting several times on the same dilemma, we process one technical item:
privacy.s2_2Item1Text: used only to recognise a submission already made and block duplicates
privacy.s2_2Item2Text: to apply that limit over time
privacy.s2_2ImportantText: This data is not used for profiling, advertising or audience measurement. It is never cross-referenced with the answers you give in the quizzes.
privacy.s2_3Intro: When you request free content (e-book, guide), we collect the following information with your explicit consent:
privacy.s2_3Item2Text: To send you the requested content and, with your consent, occasional informational communications
privacy.s2_3Item3Text: To identify the content you requested
privacy.s2_3ImportantText: You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us at the address indicated below. Your data will then be deleted within 30 days.
privacy.s3Intro: Quiz Couple uses Google Analytics 4 to measure site traffic, and Google AdSense to display ads. Both services place cookies in your browser.
privacy.s3Item1: Both services follow Google Consent Mode v2: no analytics or advertising cookie is placed before you give explicit consent through our banner
privacy.s3Item2: If you decline, no browsing data is collected and any ads shown are not personalised
privacy.s3Item3: Analytics data is anonymised and cannot be used to identify you personally
privacy.s3Item4: If you accept, Google AdSense may use your browsing to personalise ads. You can change this at any time from Google ad settings
privacy.s3Outro: You can change your choice at any time by clearing your browser cookies. For more information on Google's cookie management, see Google's privacy policy.
privacy.s4Intro: We implement the following security measures to protect your browsing:
privacy.s4Item1Text: All communications between your browser and our site are encrypted
privacy.s4Item2Text: Technical data is stored securely with strict access policies
privacy.s4Item3Text: We only collect data strictly necessary for the service to function
privacy.s4Item4Text: We follow best practices in secure web development
privacy.s5Intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy.s5Item1Text: Obtain confirmation of whether your data is being processed
privacy.s5Item4Text: Receive your data in a structured format
privacy.s5Item5Text: Object to the processing of your data
privacy.s5Outro: To exercise these rights regarding usage limitation data, contact us at the address below.
privacy.s6Text: The site itself is hosted by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States). The data you send us is stored in a database managed by Supabase, acting as a processor under the GDPR. This covers the first name and comment you leave in a review, messages sent through the contact form, the email address and first name provided when requesting free content, and the anti-duplicate technical data described in 2.2. Quiz plays are counted in a form that cannot identify you: only the test name and the language are recorded, never your answers. None of these processors is allowed to use this data for its own purposes.
privacy.s7Text: Our site may contain links to external sites. We invite you to consult the privacy policies of these sites, as we are not responsible for their data protection practices.
privacy.s8Text: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an update date. We encourage you to check this page regularly.

mentions.s7Text: The Quiz Couple website may contain hyperlinks to other sites. However, Thomas Owaller is not able to verify the content of sites visited in this way and therefore disclaims all liability for any potential risks of illegal content.
mentions.s8P1: Quiz Couple takes part in affiliate programmes. In practice, some links on the site point to partners, and a purchase made after following one of those links may earn us a commission. The price you pay is exactly the same either way.
mentions.s8P2: We would rather say so plainly than let you work it out. Every page that carries this kind of link shows a visible notice, right where the link appears, so you always know what you are dealing with before you click.
mentions.s8P3: These partnerships never decide what we write. We only keep partners whose offer relates directly to couple life, whose quality we would consider good enough to recommend to someone close to us, and who stay in line with the site's editorial stance. A partner that no longer meets those conditions is dropped, commission or not.
mentions.s9Text: These legal notices are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, French courts shall have sole jurisdiction.
